Build kit for "Avatar - Photo"

Start from the TEMPLATE, fill it with BLOCKS, and use COMPONENTS only for what is left.
Changing a page you already have? Keep it, and use only the blocks and components.

TEMPLATE
The idea is a part of a page and names no page, so it starts from the app shell. Scaffold it, then put blocks inside it.

name:        shell-top-nav
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Application frame with horizontal navigation only: a centered bar whose items open full-width mega-menu panels, over placeholder content that keeps the entire width.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template shell-top-nav --type page <path>

Install missing dependencies: npm install @heroicons/react@"^2.2.0"

This template uses StyleX. Your project needs a StyleX compiler plugin - see `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs styling-overview` for setup steps.

OTHER TEMPLATES
If the layout is wrong, scaffold one of these instead. All page templates: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template --list --type page

name:        classic-gallery
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Uniform grid of equal-ratio media tiles under a centered intro, with filter tabs that narrow the set in place.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template classic-gallery --type page <path>

name:        mixed-gallery
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Masonry grid of variable-height tiles that pack against each other instead of cropping to a shared ratio, captioned per tile.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template mixed-gallery --type page <path>

Keyword search matched these page templates: centered-hero (@astryxdesign/core), classic-gallery (@astryxdesign/core), gallery-hero (@astryxdesign/core).

BLOCKS
Ready-made sections for parts the template lacks (top 3 of 5; --verbose for all). Print one: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template <name>

name:        AvatarWithImage
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Show a profile photo at different sizes.

name:        AvatarFallbackChain
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Demonstrates the avatar fallback chain: primary image, fallback image, initials, then default icon.

name:        AvatarInteractive
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Make an avatar interactive by passing `href` to render it as a link or `onClick` to render it as a button.

COMPONENTS

description: AvatarGroup displays multiple avatars in an overlapping row with an optional overflow indicator.
